title: Three Names
text: The last of the survey team stops moving at the foot of a dune. The wind starts covering them at once. On the channel Marrow says their names, all three, and then the channel goes quiet.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Dunmore keeps what it has.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The Command Core's card lists the way home.
